# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

MétaCan welcomes respectful participation from people working on metaresearch, bibliographic data, research software, and reproducible science. Participation should be free from harassment and exclusionary behaviour.

## Expected behaviour

Participants are expected to:

- Respect different backgrounds, experience levels, and viewpoints.
- Keep disagreement focused on evidence, reproducible examples, and maintainable solutions.
- Accept constructive feedback and correct mistakes when they are identified.
- Credit prior work, data sources, standards, and contributors.
- Keep issue and pull request discussion relevant to the stated topic.

## Unacceptable behaviour

Harassment, discriminatory language, personal attacks, publication of private information, unwanted sexual attention, intimidation, stalking, and sustained disruption are unacceptable.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately to <ahmad.pub@gmail.com>. Do not open a public issue for a conduct report. Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical.

## Attribution

This code of conduct is based on the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1: <https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>.
